title: A Friday Evening
setting: A bright, clean family home: a kitchen and a living room with a sofa.

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: her dad Omar, a tall man with short black hair and glasses

characters.name: Baby
characters.look: her baby brother, a chubby baby in a white onesie

sentences.en: On Friday evening, Nina cooks rice for dinner.
sentences.zh: 星期五晚上，妮娜煮米饭当晚餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt stirs a pot of rice on the stove in the evening.

sentences.en: She spills some water on the clean floor.
sentences.zh: 她把一些水洒在了干净的地板上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt looks surprised as water splashes from a jug onto a shiny clean floor.

sentences.en: Nina is sorry, but Dad just smiles.
sentences.zh: 妮娜很抱歉，但爸爸只是笑了笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt looks sorry with her hands together while her dad Omar, a tall man with short black hair and glasses smiles kindly and holds a mop.

sentences.en: After dinner, Dad washes the baby's feet.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，爸爸给宝宝洗脚。
sentences.scene_prompt: her dad Omar, a tall man with short black hair and glasses gently washes the little feet of her baby brother, a chubby baby in a white onesie in a small bowl of water.

sentences.en: The baby often laughs when Nina says his name.
sentences.zh: 妮娜一叫宝宝的名字，他就常常咯咯笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: her baby brother, a chubby baby in a white onesie laughs happily while Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt leans in and calls to him.

sentences.en: Then Nina sits on the sofa with a book.
sentences.zh: 然后妮娜拿着一本书坐到沙发上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt sits on a soft sofa in the living room, opening a book.

sentences.en: It is a history book about France.
sentences.zh: 这是一本关于法国历史的书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt holds a book with an old French castle on the cover.

sentences.en: She reads half of it and dreams of holidays.
sentences.zh: 她读了一半，梦想着去那里度假。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl of ten with long brown hair and a yellow shirt on the sofa with a half-read book, a dream bubble showing a sunny holiday in France.
